title: Home entry
note: Keep the existing Home hierarchy. Only the Check My Meal entry is revised; adjacent modules are unchanged.

title: Your meals · active
note: Default hub. General real-meal scope is explicit; Explore care is optional. No daily calorie budget or one-meal quota.

title: Choose a care interest
note: Browsing only. Six draft categories demonstrate capability, not launch approval. Do not write selected interest to the clinical record.

title: Preview · heart health
note: One preview template. Every visible section belongs to this category and is labelled as education, not a personal diet.

title: Preview · diabetes
note: Category content changes, but the real-meal engine does not. A visible Your meals tab leads back to general checking.

title: Preview · blood pressure
note: Three nutrient topics are supplied for this source profile. Do not force every category to show four chips.

title: Preview · kidney care
note: No specific mineral/protein/fluid limits or blanket food prescription. Do not mix this preview with a real-meal verdict.

title: Preview · dialysis
note: Separate content identity from non-dialysis. No medication/binder timing or personal treatment advice is published here.

title: Preview · recovery
note: Recovery is a draft content category, not automatic recovery-programme enrolment or rehabilitation advice.

title: First use · explanation
note: Shown before creating a real check. Consent text needs Privacy approval. Informational previews do not require image processing.

title: Safety & food preferences
note: All six source fields remain explicit. This long page scrolls. No missing answer defaults to No/None; factual safety mode is derived by the server.

title: Add a meal
note: Camera, gallery and manual entry plus an editable meal slot. This review mock never uploads a real image.

title: Camera permission denied
note: Permission state variant, not a new nutrition flow. Offer gallery/manual routes and native settings guidance.

title: Manual food catalogue
note: Approved searchable preparation records. Search/add/edit interactions need existing catalogue identifiers, not model-created nutrient values.

title: Food & portion editor
note: Update preparation/quantity from governed choices. Confirmation is invalidated by every edit; no zero or missing portion.

title: Recognition in progress
note: Identity/portion candidates only. Cancellation terminates work. No clinician-review wording; no nutrient verdict before confirmation.

title: Confirmation · unresolved
note: An unresolved item disables calculation. User must map, replace or explicitly remove it. No guess or silent omission.

title: Confirmation · ready
note: Explicit confirmation required even with high-confidence image recognition. One server revision produces one immutable result.

title: General meal result
note: Illustrative numeric fixture, not a real meal. Server supplies all rows and observations; preview category is absent from the analysis context.

title: Nutrient facts only
note: Same result template, safety variant. No targets, traffic lights, suitability judgement, suggestions or glucose-impact category.

title: Meal history
note: Only completed checks. Multiple entries in one meal slot are allowed; these are not proof of consumption or a daily intake total.

title: Historical result detail
note: Original result and original context. Changing browsing category or current rules never rewrites history. Edit creates a new authorised draft.

title: Free analysis ended
note: New camera/gallery/manual analysis is locked. History and approved care previews remain readable. No timer restart from browsing/purchase.

title: Preview · paid order pending
note: Commercial state variant. Replace Explore plans with Track activation; preview selection cannot create a second primary order.

title: Preview content unavailable
note: No stale revoked, partial or unrelated-category content. Other permitted activities remain available. Unknown required blocks fail safely.

title: Meal recognition failure
note: No sample-meal substitution. Retry/manual recovery uses the original attempt deadline. A new draft requires new authorisation.

title: Empty meal history
note: History empty state; no fabricated examples in personal records. Illustrative review fixtures are not production records.
